reason: I'd maybe click through and try a couple of the free sessions, but I already get postpartum workouts free on YouTube when I have a spare ten minutes, and I can't see myself paying for the 8-week bit. Honestly, 45 minutes a day with two kids is not happening, so I'd probably never even finish the free five weeks.
objection: 45 minutes a day is unrealistic for me, and I can't see what this gives me that the free YouTube postpartum videos don't.
would_change_my_mind: If it came in 15-minute sessions and a physio or a mum in my group vouched that it actually fixed their tummy gap or pelvic floor.
